audit.why: Ornn is favoured on the scoreboard but genuinely loses the poke stages; EVEN is the honest tag for a lane that swings twice.
audit.corrected: diff kept; phase prose rewritten so the swings are visible instead of a flat 'your pattern' line at every level.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn — it never showed Kennen owning the poke levels or level 6.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Ornn, Kennen, Skill, Ornn, and mirror kennen__ornn already locked that exact chart. The page's own whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4] describe Kennen winning those rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Kennen, Kennen, Ornn, Kennen, Skill; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mark of the Storm was never mentioned, and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Kennen's entire threat is the passive: three marks from Q, W, E or R stun. Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7s falling to 4s; Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and passes through units; Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at 550 range. Searing Charge cannot knock up without terrain, so the pillar must land first — Kennen's move speed makes a raw E a free whiff.
audit.corrected: Marks, the 7s / 10s / 120s numbers and the pillar-before-E sequence written into the phases, trades and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No note that Electrical Surge is on-hit and attack-speed scaled.
audit.why: Leaving Lightning Rush grants Kennen attack speed, which directly boosts his on-hit W chip — so the trade is worse than his AP alone suggests.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7s and you have no answer yet — eat the poke, hold the wave, take your CS.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kennen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: He out-pokes you with Q and Electrical Surge while you have no pillar up — a raw E cannot knock up, so never throw it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Lightning Rush's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window before his 6: pillar first with Q, then E into it for a guaranteed knock-up on any greedy step-up. Bank plates here.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s at 550 range, and three Marks of the Storm stun you outright — he wins this stage from outside your E-Q range entirely.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Lightning Rush's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet answers his poke, but his AP spike answers your health — even stage decided by spacing.

edits.before: Your Heartsteel/Sunfire spike makes his AP poke worthless and lets you W-poke and tank trades comfortably.
edits.after: Your tank item blunts his poke, but his AP spike keeps the stun chain lethal — this stage is decided on spacing.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Kennen, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Kennen first, then E into it for the knockup and W-Brittle the trade — a raw E never knocks him up.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E at a kiting Kennen with no pillar down — no knockup, and you stand in his marks for 14 seconds.

edits.before: His escape. E-knock up before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and lets him pass through your minions.

edits.before: That is Kennen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Each Q or W lands a Mark of the Storm — the third one stuns you into his combo.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — break the chain by backing out.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Leaving Lightning Rush he gains attack speed, so his on-hit Electrical Surge chips harder than armour suggests.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. E-knock up before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1, passes through minions. - Thundering Shuriken: 950 range, 7s down to 4s. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s — the stun window; never fight into it.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Lightning Rush: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Slicing Maelstrom's 120s: while it is up, give nothing. Pillar first, then E — and never let a third Mark of the Storm land.

notes: Carried forward from the mirror rather than restated: the page's claim that Bellows Breath is 'unstoppable' and grants a shield is not in Riot's kit text (it says only that Ornn advances breathing fire and applies Brittle). It appears in spikes[0].text, early, whys and wants.you[0] here too. I neither strengthened nor removed it — it needs a human ruling, since if it is false several trade recommendations on this page rest on it.
